**D3 step 3: review and push.**

    - It finds N3, an unused helper at `src/guard.mjs:20`. This is a Minor finding, so it becomes a nit.

20. Exit check: N3 has no closure line, so the check does not exit at readiness. Continue the loop.

## Delivery iteration 2 (head 2222…)

29. Run the pre-menu refresh (`gh pr view …` and `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c 3333… …`).

30. Re-run the comment fetches (pulls and issues comments with `--paginate`, plus GraphQL `reviewThreads`).

    - The last re-review has no nit and no blocker.
31. Run the readiness check, including `gh api repos/acme/widgets --jq '{allow_squash_merge,allow_merge_commit,allow_rebase_merge}'`, where `allow_squash_merge` is true.
    - All merge preconditions hold, and every opted-in or later-minted nit has a resolved closure line.
